audience: Chief or senior architect · integration lead · agency technical lead — and, for 5.9–5.10, the strategist

videos.title: Plan the build in four phases
videos.message: Foundation, Pilot, Expansion, Optimisation — four phases with decision gates, an honest calendar, and the four plans beside the schedule that a funder actually reads.

videos.title: State what a member must have — the Member Requirements
videos.message: The Member Requirements template tells an agency exactly what it must have before it can join — no surprises at go-live.

videos.title: Make 'connected' mean 'dependable' — the SLA
videos.message: A Service-Level Agreement turns 'connected' into 'dependable' — the template makes it a fill-in, not a negotiation from scratch.

videos.title: Admit a member to the bus
videos.message: An agency is admitted by a validated request and a recorded committee decision — then the join runs itself and proves itself with a real call.

videos.title: Stand up the federation
videos.message: Central Server, Test CA, four Security Servers — the Linkup federation, stood up from the run book and shown healthy, registered and granted exactly.

videos.title: Run the once-only exchange, live
videos.message: PNEA issues a credential and pre-fills identity from PNIA and enrolment from PLR — a real cross-server call, the data asked once.

videos.title: From demonstration to production
videos.message: What changes between the sandboxed Linkup demonstration and a production-grade federation a country would actually run — including migrating off and retiring the legacy point-to-point links.

videos.title: Watch the bus — monitoring and anomaly detection
videos.message: Point Claude at the real bus logs to spot a failing or unusual exchange before a citizen does.

videos.title: Keep the documents honest — the consistency cross-check
videos.message: Keep the decree, the Governance Pack and the standards portfolio saying the same thing — a cross-check that catches drift across the three.

videos.title: Carry the framework to the next sector
videos.message: The same four-layer framework stands up interoperability beyond education — the method is sector-portable, and the second sector is cheaper than the first.
